13. (Currently amended) A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, __and wherein the contact elements are electrically isolated from the respiratory gas passage__.

14. (Previously presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body.

15. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising __a removably attachable insulating sheathing body__.

16. (Cancelled)

17. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body includes a multi-layered design __and is removably attachable to the flexible tube__.

18. (Previously presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube.

19. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein __the heater is integrated into the flexible tube__.

24. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from __a spirally reinforced plastic material having a wall thickness configured to accommodate the integrated heater__.

25. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is __an electrical resistance heating element__.

26. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage __such that both an electric connection for power delivery and a pneumatic connection for gas delivery are provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device__.

27. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each __contact element is provided within the second portion__.

28. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion __extends radially outwardly from the first portion__.

29. (Currently amended) A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage __such that both an electric connection for power delivery and a pneumatic connection for gas delivery are provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device, and wherein the contact elements are electrically isolated from the respiratory gas passage__.

30. (Currently amended) A connector according to claim 29, wherein each __contact element is provided within the second portion__.

31. (Currently amended) A connector according to claim 29, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion __extends radially outwardly from the first portion__.
